notes.title: RULE THE WORLD
notes.notes:
In the new game mode RULE THE WORLD, you don't have to save the world, you can conquer it.
Battle your political opponents and reign the world. This mode can be played simultaneously with the 7DTSTW simulation. If you proceed and master the simulation, you get stronger and gain benefits in your RULE THE WORLD battles.

ARE YOU READY FOR REAL POLITICAL COMBAT???
